messages:
Elaine (partnerships): Hey team — quick sync. We have a handful of private offers coming up that are eligible for early-renewal opt-ins from customers. Thinking we run a 2-week retention sprint to convert at-risk customers into 12-month committed private offers. Thoughts?
Matt (sales): +1. Do we have a list of target accounts + their current usage pace?
Elaine (partnerships): I pulled a preliminary list — 18 accounts with >60% usage forecast and upcoming renewals in Q2. Will share spreadsheet shortly.
Jamal (ops): Can we guarantee SKU parity and entitlements for private offers? Need to confirm Dedicated capacity mapping before we promise anything.
Sophia (product): We should include an SLA-match option in the offer — low-latency tier for mission-critical apps. That will help with conversion.
Oliver (finance): Pricing thought: offer a modest commit discount (10–15%) plus a one-time onboarding credit. Need margin calc; share expected ARR impact.
Elaine (partnerships): Proposed play: 12-month private offer, 12% commit discount, optional SLA uplift (+5% price adder), 1-month onboarding credit applied at invoice. Ops: can you confirm capacity mapping by EOD Friday?
Jamal (ops): I'll run a capacity fit check. If customers need dedicated pools we may need 2–4 week provisioning. Call that out in offer timeline.
Matt (sales): Templated pitch would help. Can we get a short bullets + FAQ?
Sophia (product): Drafting a short FAQ: fallbacks if capacity tight, permitted quantization levels, data residency notes. Will post by tomorrow.
deploy-bot: New private-offer draft created: PO-DRAFT-2026-04-15, owners: @Elaine, @Matt.
Oliver (finance): Please add a clause for pro-rata early termination and renewal crediting. Finance prefers standardized language.
Elaine (partnerships): Agreed. Also want a simple playbook for field: 1) qualification checklist 2) pricing calculator link 3) ops SLA gating 4) legal/finance signoff. I can sketch the checklist this afternoon.
Matt (sales): I can run a short pilot with 3 accounts next week if ops can do the provisioning gating.
Jamal (ops): OK for pilot — will reserve a small Dedicated pool and flag required lead time.
Sophia (product): Note: recommend adding an explicit fallback model variant (quantized) if Dedicated capacity unavailable — keeps apps running with degraded perf but avoids failed requests.
Oliver (finance): For renewals, set automatic invoice trigger 30 days before renewal window. Also include a renewal incentive (1 month free on re-up).
Elaine (partnerships): Great. Action items: Elaine — draft checklist & share spreadsheet; Sophia — FAQ & fallback language; Jamal — capacity gating + provisioning lead times; Oliver — finalize pro-rata/renewal legal wording; Matt — pilot outreach list. Will reconvene next Tue. :thumbsup:
Matt (sales): Sounds good. I'll prep outreach email templates.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: retention-sprint-checkin in 7 days.
